text:
The immediate-after constraints form two blocks: Hana–Gus–Dev in three consecutive slots, and Finn–Ben in two. Exactly one slot between Dev and Elif cannot place Elif before Dev, because that slot is Hana’s, so Elif is two after Dev. Ann must sit strictly between Hana and Elif, which leaves only the slot between Dev and Elif.

Exactly one slot between Ben and Elif then puts Finn–Ben immediately after Elif. Exactly one slot between Cara and Finn puts Cara immediately after Ben. That is eight consecutive slots, Hana through Cara. The only start that leaves a free slot before Finn is slot 2, and that free slot is 1, so Ivo takes it. Every “at least three apart” constraint holds on this assignment, and every other start or order collides with a fixed block.
